inspected_anchors.finding: Abstract and introduction claim theory and empirical improvements; neither is adopted on title alone.
Sensitivity is an expectation; Remark3.3 states it is below the supremum. Entropy-gap calibration differs from probability calibration.
Assumptions and Eqs10-14: entropy subtraction and expected-to-supremum substitution require scrutiny; selection uses an unconditional baseline.
Training/inference require distributions, perturbations and entropy; sampled proxy does not identify latent semantics.

Tasks described generically; tables report improvements but inspected text lacks exact model/checkpoint, dataset release/split/sample count and run/seed identity. Classification and perturbation limitations explicit.
AppendixA.1 substitutes the risk of a different action in the wrong direction, removes a nonnegative addend, reverses lambda inequality and replaces supremum by lower expectation.
AppendixA.2 does not establish its lower calibration step and changes weighted bin aggregation. A.3 eta may make bound vacuous; A.5 adds easier-covered-set assumption.
AppendixB reports scores with unresolved underlying run identity; Table4 explicitly records invariance failure with no SUA signal.

sources.title: Authored counterexamples to sensitivity-entropy risk and calibration guarantees
sources.author: Causal banking proposal project
inspected_anchors: calculate: eq11_constant_fair, eq10_constant_loss, rare_perturbation, conditional_selection, equal_entropy_wrong_labels, many_to_one_interpretations, KL_linear_constant
supported_claims: Constant fair model with psi0 violates Eq11:1/2 is not <=1/2-log2.
Constant bounded loss1/2 and concave psi(h)=(1-exp(-h))/2 violate Eq10:1/2 is not <=1/4.
Full-support perturbation probability1/100 gives expectedTV1/200 but worstTV1/2.
Low-score hard subgroup has conditional self-risk1/2 versus unconditional1/20.
Label-probability swap gives equal entropy but error9/10; many-to-one interpretations give positive latent entropy and zero label entropy.
Near equality, bounded-loss change/KL diverges; a uniform linear KL constant is not supplied by boundedness.
